mapper.insert: insert into review (item_id, reviewer_id, target_id, rating, content) values (#{itemId}, #{reviewerId}, #{targetId}, #{rating}, #{content})
mapper.select: select count(*) from review where item_id = #{itemId} and reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}
select r.*, u.nickname as reviewerNickname from review r left join `user` u on r.reviewer_id = u.id where r.target_id = #{userId} order by r.created_at desc
select ifnull(round(avg(rating), 1), 0) as avgRating, count(*) as reviewCount from review where target_id = #{userId}
